claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows paint wear, rust spots, scratches, grime, oxidation, and a cracked table top
No video or test-stitch clip showing motor running or needle operation
No demonstration of operational readiness; implies no repairs needed, which cannot be confirmed from a static photo

risks.risk: Motor/needle may not function despite visible wear suggesting heavy use
risks.proof: Short video of machine powered on, stitching a scrap of fabric

risks.risk: Accessories (bobbins, extra needles, foot pedal, wiring) may be missing or damaged
risks.proof: Close-up photo of foot pedal, wiring, and accessory set
risks.if_unproven: priced as incomplete, accessories not included

risks.risk: Electrical wiring or motor housing could be unsafe or corroded
risks.proof: Photo of motor housing and wiring from underside/back

risks.risk: Table and drawers may be structurally unstable (crack line noted)
risks.proof: Video of drawers opening/closing and table being pushed to show wobble
risks.if_unproven: priced as unstable furniture, needing repair

risks.risk: Unknown age/usage history affecting remaining lifespan
risks.proof: Any purchase receipt, service record, or seller statement on age (not sufficient alone but helps triangulate)

proof_requests: Video of the machine running with a test stitch on fabric
Close-up photos of motor housing, wiring, and foot pedal
Video showing drawers opening and table stability test
Photo of any accessories included (extra bobbins, needles, manual)
response.reason: Identity is settled as a used FLY industrial sewing machine with visible wear; the seller's 'good condition/working perfectly' claims are contradicted or unverifiable from the photos, so it must be priced at worst case (heavily worn, unproven function) until video/photo proof is provided.
